title: Backing up your data
description: Keep a safe copy of your AftLog data.

steps.text: Tap Export / Backup to create a JSON file.
AftLog saves it to your Downloads folder.
Keep it somewhere safe — cloud, computer, or USB.

tips: Backups include boats, logs, intervals, and manuals.
Do one before switching phones or restoring.
examples: A monthly backup to cloud storage.
